evidenceBoundary.direct: Named decoded call targets and selected metadata field-offset accesses in exact .pdata bodies and unwind-owned fragments; typed inheritance and declared override absence where specified.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Native default bodies only; runtime IFix selection and actual activation remain unobserved. Offset-access checks alone do not prove receiver type or complete control/data flow.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Server decision rules, Mission quest to LevelScript task ownership, asynchronous request/reply ownership, unvisited routes and successful returns.

compareStoredProgress.contract: The default comparison reads the selected receiver's virtual comparison operator, current progress and target, then calls DoCompare. It is separate from cached m_result and does not prove live values or a server completion rule.

storedObjectiveValue.contract: The default body passes its stored condition id and values dictionary to GetValueOrDefault. This lookup is separate from objective display aggregation and does not attribute an incoming packet to a live condition.

combineDisplayedProgress.contract: The default body enumerates the stored children and dispatches their progress-for-show getter through its selected metadata slot. Accumulation and objective branch selection require the separately reviewed body flow.

combineDisplayedTarget.contract: The default body enumerates the stored children and dispatches their target-for-show getter through its selected metadata slot. This presentation target is distinct from the incoming values dictionary.

objectiveShowData.contract: The owned default body fragments call the objective presentation getters and write separate current and target fields on the display record. Field-offset predicates alone do not prove every receiver or the completion-dependent choice of value.

Beyond.Gameplay.CheckTalkOptionFinish.On.contract: Native default activation resolves/caches authored operands, checks existing history, and binds both server-history notifications.
Native default deactivation unbinds the same two global event keys.

Beyond.Gameplay.CinematicSystem.get_dial.contract: Returns the client-side dialog history dictionary on its native default path.

Beyond.Gameplay.CinematicSystem._Handle_.contract: Server sync payload clears/repopulates retained client dialog history before sending ON_SYNC_ALL_DIALOG.
Server finish payload creates the dialog-id/options/finish-numbers record and replaces the client dictionary entry before notification and NPC/level refresh.

Beyond.Gameplay.CinematicSystem.SendFini.contract: Native method builds a CS_FINISH_DIALOG request from authored dialog identity and selected finish/options; this claim does not prove delivery.

Beyond.Gameplay.Core.DialogManager.SetFi.contract: Caches supplied finish id in DialogManager; this method alone does not update server history.

Beyond.Gameplay.Core.DialogManager._Send.contract: DialogManager server-send path forwards supplied finishId and optionIds arguments to CinematicSystem.SendFinishDialog; this method does not read the cached m_finishId itself.

Beyond.Gameplay.Core.DialogManager._Afte.contract: Native after-exit path has an explicit conditional server-send call before its exit-callback invocation; its finishId source is a stack local here and the complete cached-field join remains unresolved.

Beyond.Gameplay.CheckActivityConditional.contract: Block-condition description reads authored activity stage id and obtains configured stage conditions; it is presentation/configuration rather than an observed completion check.
The authored block predicate is admitted only for comparer GreaterEqual and target state Unlocked on its native default path.

Beyond.Gameplay.GameConditionServer.OnAc.contract: Base server condition native default branch returns without a local gameplay call; an IFix override can replace this behavior.

Beyond.Gameplay.GameConditionServer.OnDe.contract: Base server condition native default branch returns without a local gameplay call; an IFix override can replace this behavior.

Beyond.Gameplay.GameCondition.set_result.contract: Changed active condition result stores m_result, calls its listener and reevaluates its parent combine condition.

clientConditionType.contract: The native default client-condition getter selects ClientOnly. Stored photo/identification objectives are capture candidates; their availability, live subtype, IFix selection and active callback invocation remain unresolved.

missionServerClassification.contract: Reviewed native branch classifies a non-ClientOnly condition as server-side; this does not reveal server policy or the live runtime subtype.

leafClientActivation.contract: Reviewed native branch returns for a non-ClientOnly leaf; the ClientOnly branch deactivates then activates with the supplied source. The primitive comparison does not itself prove the complete branch.

combinedClientActivation.contract: Reviewed native loop recurses into exact CombineCondition children; other children are dispatched only when their virtual type is ClientOnly. Concrete dispatch and branch flow remain reviewed interpretation.

clientResultCallbackBinding.contract: Reviewed native traversal recursively visits exact combined children and installs a result-change delegate only on ClientOnly leaves; this does not authenticate a later delegate invocation or request owner.

Beyond.Gameplay.CheckTalkOptionFinish.ge.contract: Native default getter returns the selected named enum member, distinct from ClientOnly; IFix replacement and live receiver type remain unresolved.

Beyond.Gameplay.CheckLevelScriptProperty.contract: Native default getter returns the selected named enum member, distinct from ClientOnly; IFix replacement and live receiver type remain unresolved.

authoredScopeMask.contract: Reviewed default path uses the virtual force-override tuple when enabled, otherwise authored scopeMask. Effective current/graph scope and execution admission are not established.

authoredGraphScope.contract: Native default path returns the authored graph-scope flag; this is not the effective scope.

receivePropertyMap.contract: The default network handler constructs a script pointer from the supplied script id and forwards the supplied property map. The packet's scene field, effective live receiver and upstream writer rule are not established by these claims.

selectScriptRuntime.contract: The default manager resolves the supplied script pointer and invokes the property synchronizer on a found runtime. A successful lookup is not observed.

applyMappedProperties.contract: The reviewed default loop requires the runtime property-id map and blackboard, looks up supplied property ids, converts supplied values, writes mapped keys and recycles temporary variables. Unknown ids, missing maps and conversion failures do not establish a write. Live values and the server's generating rule remain unresolved.

briefPropertyIdMap.contract: The reviewed default getter obtains its property-id map from the script brief data; offset predicates alone do not establish both receiver types. The full LevelScriptData graph's nullable property map is a separate stored field.

resolvePropertyOperands.contract: Reviewed native activation resolves authored operands and caches the script/property identity and boolean comparison operand before checking.

initialPropertyCheckAndSubscription.contract: Reviewed native path reads a boolean property, compares it, stores a condition result and registers its property-change callback. Getter success, live activation and writer identity are not proved.

propertyChangeBooleanResult.contract: Reviewed native callback compares the event blackboard boolean with its configured operand and assigns a result. It does not count markers or establish mission ownership.

removePropertySubscription.contract: Native default deactivation removes the stored property listener.

propertyPacketForwarding.contract: Named client packet handler forwards to retained entity-data synchronization on its default path; entry is not acknowledgment.

retainedEntityPropertyDelivery.contract: Selected body and unwind-owned fragments read packet identity and check pending release before the named retained-data consumer; this is not a general packet-id/logic-id equivalence.

interactivePropertyContainerUpdates.contract: Default property delivery converts wire values and reaches server blackboard mutation and a separate loaded-entity blackboard branch. Navigation dispatch is a conditional state consumer. Named calls alone do not prove loop member transfers or active IFix paths.

wireParameterConversion.contract: Wire real/value type tags and integer-list storage are read by the converter; scalar values and lists must not be conflated, and no generic value layout is inferred.

blackboardVariableMutation.contract: Default setter consults the keyed variable dictionary through the named lookup. Its remaining mutation helpers have no admitted named identity here; existing-value behavior, inserted values and concrete generic numeric layouts remain unresolved.

evidenceBoundary.direct: Selected named calls and field-offset accesses in bounded bodies and their unwind-owned fragments.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Default client consumer paths; loaded-entity and navigation branches have their own conditions.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Incoming map members, copied concrete variable values, actual executed writes, live IFix selection and Mission ownership.

excludedChecks.coldFragmentEnumForwarding: Primary-body-only passesEnumMemberToCall does not cover the owned SucceedQuest fragment; current manual byte chain remains in the generated report.
excludedChecks.progressSetterLeaf: The selected GameCondition.set_progress leaf lacks a .pdata boundary; it is not admitted by the bounded reusable evaluator.
